why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read how Forge works Start with the Ankr Forge overview , which explains Heats, Forge Points and Forge Drops.
2 Step 2 : Enter the Forge Open the Ankr Forge page from the Ankr site and set up your account there.
3 Step 3 : Hold ANKR to qualify a wallet Holding ANKR determines whether your wallet is eligible for a Forge Drop, and it also earns points passively.

4 Step 4 : Complete missions in the Kite campaign Heat 2 opened with a Kite campaign. Its missions sit next to the standing Ankr missions, and each one closes when its campaign ends. Missions include on-chain transactions, asset bridging and app interactions.
5 Step 5 : Keep earning through the Heat Your Forge Points in the current Heat set your share of that Heat's Forge Drops, so missions completed before each Drop snapshot count.
